verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 104.5 (+2.7% in a day) and momentum is 36: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 1,600 and 86s 3,800. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-15T18:44:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Buy Selma Bacha 86 after its 32% fall, sell in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 12,250 coins. Now 11,750. Buy the dip: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often recovers part of the fall within two days. Picked because it is down 31.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 0 of 2 so far, averaging -15.9% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Buy Mapi León 88 for the weekend, sell by Friday evening
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 11,000 coins. Now 9,700. Buy before the weekend: meta cards are bought for Champions weekend, so they often rise from midweek to Friday evening. Picked because it is meta rating 91 at CB for 11,000 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 1,600 (0.76 coins per Item Score point), 86s 3,800 (0.93 coins per Item Score point), 87s 5,700 (1.04 coins per Item Score point), 88s 9,700 (1.17 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Elliot Anderson and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Elliot Anderson 85 Team of the week -79.7%; Florian Thauvin 84 Team of the week -77.1%; Cristian Romero 84 Team of the week -74.3%; Marco Rente 80 Team of the week -74.3%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Carlos Espí SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 36.5K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
